build_mask_rcnn_detector: build a Mask R-CNN detector with a backbone, RPN head, and ROI head for instance segmentation
train_mask_rcnn_forward: run forward training on the Mask R-CNN model with ground truth bboxes, labels, and masks
test_mask_rcnn_simple: test the Mask R-CNN detector on input images without augmentation and return predictions
extract_mask_rcnn_features: extract features from the Mask R-CNN backbone and neck for downstream analysis
init_mask_rcnn_weights: initialize the Mask R-CNN detector weights including backbone, RPN head, and ROI head
